remarks:
Be First! Either purchase to live in or rent out, You start up to the back deck with plenty of room for a dining area and play area. Then enter through the back door. The basement entrance is immediately to your left. proceed to lovely kitchen with an island and all stainless appliances included. Lots of cupboards for storage and counterspace for the chef in the family.  Dishwasher, microwave, stove and refrigerator, are all included plus washer and dryer are off of the kitchen area and adjacent to a full bath. Also, a mirrored closet for boots and shoes. Next is the dining room with an attractive chair rail and windows making it bright and airy. The lovely dining room table and chairs are included in the sale.  From there to the large living room consisting of two sections, one with a bay window. The other section accommodates a sectional couch, included in the sale. plus room for a lot more furniture. 
When you come in the front door, this will bring back memories of your prom in high school, as it has a freshly painted spiral staircase, which is waiting for your personal touch, then on to 3 bedrooms, plus a full bath with a new insert in the shower/tub. That also, has a small bay window, which brings character to the house. The 3rd floor attic has stairs going up and is finished. The attic has a queen bed included with the sale. 
Nice front porch, with a huge maple in the front for shade, when you would like to enjoy the front porch.
OPEN HOUSE ON OCTOBER 3RD FROM 1PM TO3PM. TAKE A BEAUTIFUL RIDE TO OLEAN NY THIS SAT!
